title: Tommy's breakfast / 过去进行时
subtitle: 汤米的早餐 / 当……正……的时候

lead.question: 「当我正做家务时，丈夫从办公室打来电话」——「正做着某事时另一件事发生了」，英语用哪两个时态搭在一起说？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象一个早晨：丈夫走进饭厅时硬币撒了一地，找也找不全；正当一家人吃早饭时，小儿子汤米捡到两枚硬币塞进嘴里，转眼就咽了下去！这里满眼都是「过去进行时 + 一般过去时」的组合：was going into the dining-room 时 dropped some coins；While we were having breakfast 时 Tommy found ...。先想想中文「正……的时候」怎么对应英文 when/while，再听这个又惊又好笑的家庭故事，最后留意结尾 change 一词的双关。
goals: 掌握过去进行时 was/were + v-ing 的构成与用法
能用 when/while/as 引导时间状语从句，把过去进行时与一般过去时搭配使用
理解过去完成时 had already swallowed 表「过去的过去」
体会 change 的双关：既是「硬币」又是「变化」
lead.summary: 第 117 课是一个小故事：今早丈夫走进饭厅时把硬币撒了一地，没找全；正当吃早饭时，小汤米捡到两枚塞进嘴里咽了下去。上午晚些时候，丈夫从办公室打电话问「汤米怎么样」，妈妈答：汤米上午跑了三次厕所，可我还没「看到硬币」（change 的双关）！第 118 课集中操练过去进行时与一般过去时的搭配。
lead.tips: ① 过去进行时 = be 的过去式 + 现在分词：was/were + v-ing，表示过去某时正在进行；② 一般过去时表示较短暂的动作（dropped, rang, found），过去进行时铺陈背景（was going, were having）；③ when/while/(just) as 都可引导时间状语从句：when + 短动作常接过去时，while 强调同时进行；④ 过去完成时 had swallowed 表示「咽下去」发生在「想抢出来」之前——过去的过去；⑤ look for 强调「寻找」的过程，find 强调「找到」的结果；⑥ change 既是「硬币」也是「变化」，结尾一句是双关（pun）。

questions.q: What does she mean by 'change' in the last sentence?
questions.zh: 最后一句中的「change」是什么意思？
questions.a: She means the coins Tommy swallowed — the pun also suggests 'any change (improvement) in his condition'.
questions.aZh: 她指的是汤米吞下去的硬币——change 还有「变化」之意，双关地暗示「汤米的情况有没有变化」。
questions.hint: 回想 change 的两个常见意思。

questions.q: When did the husband drop the coins?
questions.zh: 丈夫是什么时候把硬币掉在地上的？
questions.a: This morning, when he was going into the dining-room.
questions.aZh: 今天早晨，当他正走进饭厅的时候。

questions.q: What did Tommy do with the two coins?
questions.zh: 汤米是怎么处置那两枚硬币的？
questions.a: He put them both into his mouth and had already swallowed them before his parents could get them back.
questions.aZh: 他把两枚硬币全塞进嘴里，父母还没来得及抢出来，他已经咽下去了。
questions.hint: 注意 too late 与 had already swallowed。

questions.q: How many times has Tommy been to the lavatory?
questions.zh: 汤米已经去了几次厕所？

questions.q: Why is the mother's last sentence funny instead of worrying?
questions.zh: 为什么妈妈最后一句听着好笑而不是让人担心？
questions.a: Because 'I haven't had any change yet' plays on two meanings of change: the coins haven't 'come out' yet, and there's been 'no change' in Tommy's condition — a calm, wry pun.
questions.aZh: 因为 change 一语双关：既指硬币还没「排出来」，又指汤米的情况「还没什么变化」——用轻松的玩笑冲淡了担心。
questions.hint: 把两个意思都套进句子里读一读。

questions.q: He ___ at the door when I was answering the phone. / When he arrived I was ___. / While I was cooking the dinner, he was ___.
questions.zh: 第 118 课操练：一般过去时（短动作）+ when + 过去进行时（背景）；while + 两个同时进行的过去进行时。
questions.a: He knocked at the door when I was answering the phone. / When he arrived I was shaving. / While I was cooking the dinner, he was cleaning his shoes.
questions.aZh: 我正接电话时他敲门。/ 他到时我正在刮胡子。/ 我做饭时他正在擦鞋。
questions.hint: 短动作用过去时，正在进行的动作用 was/were + v-ing。

meanings.usage: go into the dining-room 走进饭厅

examples.en: When my husband was going into the dining-room, he dropped some coins on the floor.
examples.zh: 我丈夫走进饭厅时，把一些硬币掉在地上了。

meanings.usage: 可数；复数 coins；与 note（纸币）相对

examples.en: There were coins everywhere.
examples.zh: 到处都是硬币。

meanings.usage: 复数 mouths /maʊðz/；put ... into his mouth

examples.en: He put them both into his mouth.
examples.zh: 他把这两枚硬币全都放进嘴里。

meanings.usage: 也指「抑制（情绪）」「吞并」：swallow one's doubts

examples.en: Tommy had already swallowed them!
examples.zh: 汤米已经把硬币咽了下去！

meanings.usage: late 的比较级；later that morning 那天上午晚些时候

examples.en: Later that morning, my husband telephoned me from the office.
examples.zh: 那天上午的晚些时候，我丈夫从办公室打来电话。

examples.en: Tommy's been to the lavatory three times this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午汤米已经去了三次厕所。

meanings.usage: 生词表中与 lavatory 同义

examples.en: Where is the toilet, please?
examples.zh: 请问厕所在哪儿？

meanings.usage: drop some coins 把硬币掉在地上（过去式 dropped）

examples.en: He dropped some coins on the floor.
examples.zh: 他把一些硬币掉在地板上了。

meanings.usage: 不可数；do the housework 做家务

examples.en: When I was doing the housework, my husband telephoned me.
examples.zh: 我正做家务时，我丈夫打来电话。

meanings.usage: 与 find（找到，强调结果）相对

examples.en: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
examples.zh: 我们虽然找了，但没有把它们全部找到。

examples.en: My husband telephoned me from the office.
examples.zh: 我丈夫从办公室打来电话。

lines.en: When my husband was going into the dining-room this morning, he dropped some coins on the floor.
lines.zh: 今天早晨我丈夫走进饭厅时，把一些硬币掉在地上了。
lines.note: was going（进行中）+ dropped（短暂动作）

lines.en: There were coins everywhere. We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
lines.zh: 到处都是硬币。我们虽然找了，但没有把它们全部找到。
lines.note: look for 过程 / find 结果

lines.en: While we were having breakfast, our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
lines.zh: 正当我们吃早饭时，我们的小男孩汤米在地上找到两枚小硬币。

lines.en: He put them both into his mouth. We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late. Tommy had already swallowed them!
lines.zh: 他把这两枚硬币全都放进嘴里。我们俩都试图把硬币拿出来，但太迟了。汤米已经把硬币咽了下去！
lines.note: 过去完成时：咽下发生在抢之前

lines.en: Later that morning, when I was doing the housework, my husband telephoned me from the office.
lines.zh: 那天上午的晚些时候，当我正做家务时，我丈夫从办公室打来电话。

lines.en: 'I don't know,' I answered, 'Tommy's been to the lavatory three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!'
lines.zh: 「我不知道，」我回答说，「今天上午汤米已经去了三次厕所了，但我还没看到硬币！」

drill.q: He ___(过去时) when I was ___. / When he arrived I was ___. / While I was cooking the dinner, he was ___.
drill.zh: 当我在……时他……了。/ 他到时我正在……。/ 我做饭时他正在……。（过去进行时与一般过去时搭配）

slots.en: answer the phone — knock at the door
wash the dishes — the phone rang
type a letter — the boss arrived
drive to London — it rained heavily
slots.zh: 开车去伦敦 — 下起大雨

slots.en: cook a meal / shave / boil the milk — when he arrived
slots.zh: 做饭/刮胡子/煮牛奶 — 当他到达时

slots.en: watch television / clean his shoes / listen to the radio — while I was cooking
slots.zh: 看电视/擦鞋/听收音机 — 当我做饭时

answers: He knocked at the door when I was answering the phone.
When he arrived I was cooking a meal.
While I was cooking the dinner, he was cleaning his shoes.

exercises.q: 汉译英：我正接电话时他敲了门。
exercises.a: He knocked at the door when I was answering the phone.
exercises.note: knocked 短动作过去时；was answering 过去进行时铺背景。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他到时我正在刮胡子。
exercises.a: When he arrived I was shaving.
exercises.note: arrive 用过去时，主句用过去进行时。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我做饭时他正在看电视。
exercises.a: While I was cooking the dinner, he was watching television.
exercises.note: while 强调两个动作同时进行。

exercises.q: 改错：When I was doing the housework, my husband telephoning me.
exercises.a: When I was doing the housework, my husband telephoned me.
exercises.note: 短暂的电话动作用一般过去时 telephoned。

exercises.q: 用过去完成时改写：Tommy swallowed the coins before we could get them.
exercises.a: Tommy had already swallowed the coins before we could get them.
exercises.note: 过去完成时表示「过去的过去」。

exercises.q: look for 与 find 选词填空：We ___ them, but we could not ___ them all.
exercises.note: look for 强调寻找过程，find 强调找到的结果。

exercises.q: 汉译英：今天上午汤米已经去过三次厕所了。
exercises.a: Tommy's been to the lavatory three times this morning.
exercises.note: has been to 去过（已回来）；区别 has gone to 去了（未回）。

options: be 的过去式 + 现在分词（was/were + v-ing）
quiz.note: 过去进行时 = was/were + 现在分词，表示过去某时正在进行。

quiz.q: When I was doing the housework, my husband ___ me. 应填：
quiz.note: 从句铺背景用进行时，主句短暂动作用一般过去时。

quiz.q: While I was cooking the dinner, he was watching television. 说明两个动作：
quiz.note: while 强调同时进行的两种动作，两个分句都用过去进行时。

quiz.q: Tommy had already swallowed them! 用过去完成时是因为：
options: 咽下发生在「想抢出来」之前（过去的过去）
quiz.note: 过去完成时表示过去两个动作中发生在前的那个。

quiz.q: 「寻找（过程）」和「找到（结果）」分别是：
quiz.note: We looked for them, but could not find them all.

quiz.q: I haven't had any change yet! 中 change 的双关意思是：
quiz.note: 既指汤米吞下的硬币还没「出来」，又指他的情况「还没变化」。

grammar.title: 过去进行时（Past Continuous）
grammar.structure: be 的过去式 + 现在分词：was/were + v-ing
grammar.definition: 过去进行时表示过去某时正在进行的情况或动作，常与一般过去时在同一句中使用：过去进行时铺陈背景，一般过去时表示较短暂的动作或事件。
grammar.usage: 时间状语从句由 when、while、(just) as 等引导；while/at the time 还可强调同时进行的几种动作。

examples.en: When I was doing the housework, my husband telephoned me from the office.
examples.zh: 当我正在干家务时，我丈夫从办公室打电话给我。

examples.en: While I was listening to the stereo, my mother came into the room.
examples.zh: 我正在听立体声节目时，我母亲进房间了。

grammar.title: when / while / as 引导的时间状语从句
grammar.structure: When + 主语 + 过去时（短动作），主语 + was/were + v-ing；While + 过去进行时，主句 + 过去进行时
grammar.definition: when 引导的从句常用一般过去时（短暂动作），主句用过去进行时；while 强调同时进行，前后都可接过去进行时；just as 表示「正当」。
grammar.usage: Just as she was cleaning her shoes, George knocked at the door.

examples.en: The phone rang when I was washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 我正洗碗时电话响了。

examples.en: While I was cooking the dinner, he was reading the paper.
examples.zh: 我做饭时他正在看报。

grammar.title: 过去完成时（had + 过去分词）
grammar.structure: had + 过去分词（already / just / before ...）
grammar.definition: 过去完成时表示过去两个动作中发生在前的那个动作，即「过去的过去」。
grammar.usage: Tommy had already swallowed them!（咽下硬币发生在父母想抢出来之前）

examples.en: Tommy had already swallowed them!
examples.zh: 汤米已经把硬币咽了下去！

examples.en: He had finished his work before I arrived.
examples.zh: 在我到达之前他已经做完了工作。

phrases.usage: 寻找（过程）/ 找到（结果）

examples.en: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
examples.zh: 我们虽然找了，但没有把它们全部找到。

examples.en: When I was doing the housework, my husband telephoned me.
examples.zh: 我正做家务时，我丈夫打来电话。

phrases.usage: 那天上午的晚些时候（later 是 late 的比较级）

examples.en: Later that morning, when I was doing the housework ...
examples.zh: 那天上午的晚些时候，当我正做家务时……

phrases.usage: 去过（已回来），现在完成时

examples.en: Tommy's been to the lavatory three times this morning.
examples.zh: 今天上午汤米已经去了三次厕所了。

examples.en: We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.
examples.zh: 我们俩都试图把硬币拿出来，但太迟了。

examples.en: When I was opening the front door, the telephone rang.
examples.zh: 我正开前门时，电话铃响了。
